artifact_note: Set by the session that publishes the dashboard (PLAN.md PR-3). The Routine fetches this URL to harvest ticks before republishing.
hpanel_baseline_note: Batched cost of the DB backlog on 2026-08-21 (5 sittings). The burn-down bar measures against this, so it only ever goes down as sessions land.
routine_note: Daily, 0 6 * * * UTC = 08:00 Europe/Stockholm (D1 default). Fresh session per firing, push on. The prompt lives in ROUTINE.md — change it there first.
scan_note: Mon+Thu, 0 5 * * 1,4 UTC — an hour before the daily nudge, push off. Incremental: only repos pushed since their last scan are deep-read. Prompt lives in SCAN.md.
